meta.title: NFL Signal Lab — strategy library, validation gates and leaderboard design
meta.principle: Every strategy is a pre-registered, reproducible rule. Luck is removed by gates, not by narrative. Model outputs are labelled; unverifiable values stay blank and are flagged.

competition.name: NFL Signal Lab Leaderboard
competition.pilot: 2026 mid-season pilot (weeks 10-18): in-house strategies only, no external entries
entryRules: Each strategy is submitted as frozen code + a written rule card before its first graded pick (pre-registration prevents result-shopping).
Pick types allowed: single bets, parlays (2-5 legs), player-prop combos (2-4 legs). Mixed-type strategies are scored per type and overall.
Picks are graded against recorded lines at submission time (market lines required — see Q-ODDS; until a verified odds source exists, forecast scoring uses Brier/log-loss against outcomes only).
No entry may change after kickoff of its first graded pick; changes create a new entry.

scoring.primary: Cumulative Brier skill score vs the competition baseline (flat 0.55 home win prob), with log-loss as tiebreaker
scoring.monetary: Units profit vs recorded line, reported separately and only once verified odds data exists (G5/G6)
scoring.parlays: Scored on joint probability forecasts (Brier on the parlay event) plus units; correlated-leg inflation is corrected by the correlation policy below

rewards: Tiered research credits: access to deeper verified datasets (gamebooks, snap counts) as they are added
Named badge on the leaderboard page and in the executive summary (no monetary prize is offered — see Q-LEGAL)
Winning rule cards are promoted into the maintained strategy library with author credit
luckRemoval: Minimum sample sizes (G1) kill lucky streaks
Baseline-relative gates (G2/G3) kill coin flips dressed as models
Deflated Sharpe / multiple-testing correction (G7) kills best-of-many luck
Bootstrap confidence intervals (G6) kill small-edge illusions
competition.governance: Submissions, gate results and re-scoring are logged on this page and in COORDINATION.md. Unverified claims never enter the board.

gates.name: Spread skill
gates.rule: Spread MAE strictly beats flat-home baseline on walk-forward backtest

gates.name: Market gate
gates.rule: ATS >= 52.4% vs recorded/closing lines over >= 200 picks
gates.status: NOT EVALUABLE — no verified odds source (Q-ODDS)

gates.name: Edge certainty
gates.rule: Bootstrap 95% CI of ROI excludes zero (10k resamples)

gates.name: Multiple-testing gate
gates.rule: Deflated Sharpe / false-discovery-rate correction across all submitted strategies

gates.name: Holdout
gates.rule: Weeks 14-18 of 2026 and the final 4 weeks of 2027 stay untouched until season end

strategies.name: Opponent-adjusted margin (full season)
strategies.rule: Team ratings R by iterative least squares on verified margins; side = sign(R_home - R_away + HFA); size flat.

strategies.name: Recency-weighted margin (lambda 0.9)
strategies.rule: Same as S1 with weights w = 0.9^(latest_week - game_week).

strategies.name: Injury/deficiency-adjusted side
strategies.rule: S2 line adjusted by a position-weighted availability score from official injury reports (Out/Doubtful/Q) and verified starter-status news; adjustment per position tier is pre-registered before grading.
strategies.data: official NFL.com weekly injury reports + official team depth charts
strategies.validation: not yet run — injury history exists only for Week 10 in this repo (Q-INJ-HIST)

computed.note: blank — first graded week is Week 10, 2026

strategies.name: Correlation-aware 2-3 leg parlay
strategies.rule: Legs drawn from S1/S2 sides and totals; joint probability computed with empirical leg correlation; stake = quarter-Kelly capped at 2% bankroll; same-game legs allowed only with published correlation penalty.
strategies.data: verified results (correlation estimation) + market prices for grading (Q-ODDS)
strategies.validation: framework defined; grading blocked until odds source exists

strategies.name: Player-prop combo
strategies.rule: 2-4 player props (passing/rushing/receiving yards, anytime TD) combined with published correlation penalties; individual prop edge must pass G1-G4 on historical prop results before combo grading.
strategies.data: official player statistics + prop market history
strategies.validation: blocked — no verified player-prop data source (Q-PROPS)

computed.note: blank — prop data not available from an official source in this session

strategies.name: Rest-advantage signal
strategies.rule: When pre-game rest difference (days since previous game) >= 4, take the more-rested side if it is not more than one rating tier worse (|ratingDiff| <= 6).
strategies.validation: signal strength measured on walk-forward weeks 5-9 (correlation 0.438 with margin — the strongest measured signal); pick-level backtest is the pilot's first graded test

computed.note: correlation computed from verified data; pick-level record blank until graded

legRules: no two legs may be the same event
same-game legs carry a published correlation penalty before joint probability is computed
parlayFramework.correlationPolicy: Joint probability bounds: lower bound max(0, sum p_i - (k-1)), upper bound min(p_i). Empirical correlations are published in correlationValues when at least 60 graded pairs exist; until then combos use the conservative lower bound.
parlayFramework.sizing: quarter-Kelly on the joint edge, capped at 2% of bankroll per ticket

requiredData: prop market history with timestamps (licensed feed — Q-PROPS/Q-ODDS)
propFramework.gates: same G1-G8, with a per-player minimum of 20 graded props
propFramework.status: defined; blocked — no verified prop source

correlationValues.computedRef: model.json signalCorrelations (Pearson, pre-game signals vs actual margin, walk-forward weeks 5-9, n=74)

computedSummary.note: undefined — constant signal this season (HFA -0.02 pts)

correlationValues.intraSignalMatrix: published on nfl-strategies.html from model.json (ratingDiff/restDiff/streakDiff/ppgDiff pairwise)
correlationValues.blankNote: Parlay and prop-pair correlation VALUES are left blank: they require graded market or prop data that this session could not verify from an official source (Q-ODDS, Q-PROPS). Framework and conservative bounds are defined above.
